title: Candidate Assessment — choose the working environment
question: The laboratory notebook keeps the question, answer and acceptance state together. Choose a direction or re-roll; the application behavior stays as specified.

options.label: The laboratory notebook
options.lineage: Working notebooks and laboratory procedure sheets
options.thesis: One open working sheet, with every accepted answer visibly accounted for.
options.viewport: A 250px question index sits beside a spacious response sheet; the fixed top band keeps time, save state and review in sight.
options.risk: The ruled structure needs generous spacing to avoid feeling like a form.

raised.raise: Keep every status beside the evidence it describes.
Give the current question an unmistakable selection.
Make time and accepted state precise measurements.
Distinguish conflicting states without relying on color.

options.label: The examination booklet
options.thesis: A familiar question booklet with quiet controls and a clear route to submission.
options.viewport: Question list at left, answer page in the center, rubric available in a side section.
options.risk: Familiar and effective; also the direction this category commonly produces.

options.label: Monochrome proof
options.thesis: Claims become answer evidence beside their rubric.
options.case: Candidate tasks gain clarity, but the marketing sequence interrupts timed work.
